title: no-html-link-for-pages: TypeError [ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE]: The "path" argument must be of type string. Received undefined

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### What version of Next.js are you using?

11.1.0

### What version of Node.js are you using?

14.17.4

### What browser are you using?

None

### What operating system are you using?

Github CI Ubuntu

### How are you deploying your application?

None

### Describe the Bug

Hello, `no-document-import-in-page` ESLint rule seems to crash in certain cases. This issue was spotted by automated CI run - it is not blocking my development or anything.

https://github.com/AriPerkkio/eslint-remote-tester/issues/246#issue-968772907


### Expected Behavior

ESLint should not crash in case of accidental imports. I'm not sure about the use case of the rule but I guess it should report since rule condition is met?

### To Reproduce

```
@next/eslint-plugin-next@11.1.0
```

```js
module.exports = {
    root: true,
    env: {
        es6: true,
        node: true,
    },
    parserOptions: {
        ecmaVersion: 2020,
        sourceType: "module",
    },
    extends: ['plugin:@next/next/recommended', 'eslint:recommended'],
    rules: {
        '@next/next/no-html-link-for-pages': 'off',
    },
};

```

### Minimal repro:

Import `next/document` in any file which is not under `/pages` directory. ESLint should not crash in case of accidental imports.

```js
import Document from 'next/document'
```
